notes.title: Damn Sexy Moves Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/d261e08ea978fa02f4a49d54193ecccf2b4ffa1a.png
Hello Everyone!

Today we're bringing the new update to Love Vibe: Aria! We have upgraded the sex system, improved interactions, added lots of new sex poses, and more!

Here is the list of changes:

 New sex positions with high-quality animations, including solo, standing, sideways, and more! Now three times more sexual positions than before.
 Improved player's climax effects.
 Added interactable penis with the option to pull out and finish on Aria.
 Sex progression system changed.
 VR pose changing improved. Grab Aria (or the indicator) and move her to change the pose. No more hard to reach sliders.
 Sex UI improved.
 VR player movement and teleport improved.
 Fixed VR camera rotation (finally).
 Added instructions panel for photo mode.
 Added option to turn off player's body parts in sex scenes (Full body, legs and penis, penis only)
 Menus changed to fit new content.
 Sex tutorials changed.
 Fixed quality setting bug which lowered Aria's model polygons count.
 Fixed many smaller bugs.



We hope that you'll like the new stuff. If you encounter any problems, please let us know.

Get Love Vibe: Aria now 40% off!

notes.title: Game doesn't work on PC screen? Here's how to run NON-VR version.
notes.notes:
We've noticed that some people have problems with running Love Vibe: Aria Non-VR version. 
If you start the game and it looks like this and you can't click on anything, follow below steps:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/a821012a777bdaa0107b448eaeedc1eb35e6c115.png

How to play the game on the PC screen.
1. Add Love Vibe: Aria - PC Edition free DLC to your Steam Library. (After purchasing Love Vibe: Aria)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091300/Love_Vibe_Aria__PC_Edition/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/58162b984fff6e9685d0d7e1e26d2e6c527590f3.png

2. Open Love Vibe: Aria page in your Steam Library and click PLAY (Launch option window will appear).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/a473aa971e3e8e0dec177101f5e7ccb96f271d10.png

3. Choose Play Non-VR Version and click PLAY button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33001755/98b238d91c3597bbb8b105b7fa2772368f2aca02.png

The game should open in Non-VR mode now.

if you still encounter any issue with starting the game, please let us know at contact@redvibestudio.com
